svg.title: What is included (light, narrow)
svg.desc: What is included: Dashboard: The real Supabase Studio, with multiple organizations and projects. Every project: Postgres, Auth, REST, GraphQL, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions and custom domains. Branching: Schema-only branches or full copies of your data, for previews and agents. Backups: Point-in-time restore from the dashboard, including Storage files. Teams: Organizations, roles, invitations, SAML single sign-on and MFA. API keys: Publishable and secret keys, legacy JWT keys and key rotation. Operations: Automatic HTTPS, health checks, alerts, security patches and signed updates. AWS: A one-field CloudFormation template. Generated by brand/build.py.
